# Own river image crops

These 410×225 crops cover only the own discard region (750,535)–(1160,760) from the before and after screenshots of a CPU friend match. They omit names, avatars and account IDs. The after image shows one 8p; the before image has no visible tile. They are image-position evidence, not proof of action, seat, legality or completeness.

The four `run116-*` crops are the same 410×225 region from a single three-player CPU friend match: 2026-11-03 05:07:05, 05:07:17, 05:07:35 and 05:08:02 UTC. Manual visual labels are respectively no visible tiles; West; West and 1p; West, 1p and 9s. These correlated frames measure missed detections, extra detections and wrong labels in that sequence only. They do not cover called-away discards, riichi orientation, later rows, duplicate tiles or occlusion; an empty result cannot prove an empty river or action success. Native frames and logs are retained under `/home/yama1/server/data/dev-work/jantama/regression-7aa6d89-116/`.
